valuation_template_rationale: ASML is a profitable, high-return lithography franchise with recurring installed-base economics; a normalized forward-earnings multiple directly exposes cycle, margin and premium-multiple sensitivity while current diluted shares and net liquidity anchor the equity bridge.
bear_assumptions: EUR 34 forward EPS at 30x as semiconductor demand normalizes, customer capacity timing slips, export restrictions tighten and gross margin retreats despite ASML's strategic position.
base_assumptions: EUR 41 forward EPS at 38x as raised 2026 guidance converts, Logic and Memory capacity commitments support demand, installed-base revenue grows and premium margins persist with cyclical volatility.
bull_assumptions: EUR 47 forward EPS at 44x as AI-led Logic and Memory investment, NXE/NXT capacity execution and High-NA adoption sustain exceptional growth, mix and margins without a material export-control shock.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh scenario set clears expected-return, base-upside, bear-payoff and margin-of-safety gates with sustained bookings, guidance conversion, cash generation and AI capacity demand; downgrade if bookings or customer commitments weaken materially, export controls impair service or shipments beyond guidance, margins structurally decline, working capital fails to convert, or roadmap and capacity execution slip.
